_comment: Entity context now serves offline generated buyer summaries from the promoted serving bundle. Runtime does not compose graph prose, scan lake Parquet, or call an LLM.
description: Serve one generated buyer-context paragraph for a property, society, or area when a passed summary fact exists in the serving bundle.

generated_summary.storage_shape: batch parquet partition; many entity summaries per run partition

api.note: 404 means no generated summary is currently promoted for the resolved entity. The UI loads this endpoint asynchronously and hides the section on 404.
